description:
Fetch structured data by URL or ASIN with optional field filters.
Pass either url (an Amazon product page URL) or asin (10-char alphanumeric).
fields (optional enum): profile | price | trend | ratings | competitiveness |
seller | facts_check | product_features | red_flags | sentiment | compatibility |
customer_say | data_limitations.
red_flags carries no confidence field: the production model (c_v4) is a pure rule-based
judge with no confidence output, so an absent confidence does not mean the verdict is certain;
weigh the verdict against data_limitations.
red_flags verdict is one of normal_growth | suspicious_review_boost | organic_burst |
insufficient_data. insufficient_data means the growth verdict was not computed because the 60-day
review growth metric was invalidated (variant jump or review rollback), not because reviews are
too few. Do not suggest obtaining more reviews to change this verdict - doing so will not affect it.
compatibility and customer_say are the device-compatibility and customer-topic blocks; each is
null when that dimension has not been computed for the ASIN.
live (optional, default false): when true, additionally hits a live data endpoint (~15-30s) and appends a "live" block with the freshest price, stock,
Buy Box seller, rating, and review count, plus data_as_of and is_stale flags.
Unknown field values return an error with the full list of allowed fields.
